q1.question: How do I view details for a location?
q1.answer: You can search for information about a location by searching for it or clicking on the location on the map.

q2.question: What area does the map cover?
q2.answer: This map focuses on the coastal corridor between Preston and Lancaster, including Blackpool, the Fylde, and the Wyre coast.

q3.question: How do I buy a ticket for a journey?
q3.answer: Our service is only for finding routes. Buy tickets using another service such as National Rail or a local bus operator website.

q4.question: How do I save routes as favourites?
q4.answer: You can save routes to your account by clicking the "Save Route" button on a route result. You need to be logged in to save routes.

q5.question: What happens if there are changes to my saved routes?
q5.answer: When potential disruptions are detected, we send a notification so you can plan ahead.

journeyHelp.title: Need help planning a journey?
journeyHelp.body: If route results look incorrect or incomplete, update your from/to stops and search again. If the issue continues, contact us with your route details and search time.

reportIssue.title: Report a disruption or data issue
reportIssue.body: Include service type (bus/train), route start and end, expected departure time, and a screenshot if possible. This helps us investigate and resolve issues faster.

accountHelp.title: Account help
accountHelp.body: For login, password, or saved route issues, open the Account tab first, then contact support if the problem persists.
